blind.description: A stylized rectangular stone wall section or mineral slab featuring a diagonal band of faceted purple and pink crystals embedded into the front face. The rock has a hand-painted, chiseled earthy brown texture with beveled fissures. The crystals project outwards in clustered hexagonal prismatic forms. The reverse side is sculpted plain rock with subtle fractures. All surfaces are solid and fully modeled without floating geometry, holes, or melting.
blind.from_above: A thick rectangular brown rock slab showing subtle beveled facets on top, with the pointed tips of the purple crystals protruding slightly from the front edge.
blind.height_vs_figure: Roughly the same height or slightly taller than the 5 ft 9 in figure (around 6 ft tall), and about half as wide (around 3 to 3.5 ft wide).

notes: footprint proportion 1.72x off the catalog (4.7 x 1.9 ft)
